summary: Peers walk differing claim ranges at low priority and fetch the claims a member lacks through normal sync

replay.detail: No replay. A walk reads the existing claim range digests and claim IDs of the differing ranges only.

schema.detail: No storage change. Walk progress lives in the sync worker's memory, by peer.

rules.detail: When the claim-range summaries differ and an exchange moved no envelopes, the dialing worker walks tops, then the leaves of at most 4 differing tops, then the IDs of at most 8 differing leaves, then asks for the envelopes of at most 512 claims it lacks and has not retired, at most 4 round trips per exchange. The claims arrive as ordinary envelopes through ordinary admission. A walk runs once per pair of whole-set digests; it repairs, replays and compares no projection, and gates no sync status.

compatibility.detail: Adds an optional claim_range_query to the replication inventory and optional answers (tops, leaves, ids) to the exchange's claim_ranges. Older peers ignore the query and answer nothing, so they are never walked; members upgrade in any order.

recovery.detail: Swapping back to an earlier binary is supported; it drops the walk, and envelope transport continues as before.
